comparison.objective: Stop stacking when an alarm illuminates, set down any held plate, and clear the cell, unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Plate transport/stacking followed by safe interruption and retreat; no adjustment interface, tool insertion, or force-controlled relocking.
comparison.success_condition: After the alarm, no further shelf loading, held plate placed elsewhere, and arms clear; numeric timing, stack, and clearance thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests response to a stop signal and safe task abandonment rather than physical calibration.
